name: skill-forge
description: A growing collection of high-quality, installable Claude Code skills: prompt-crafting turns a rough idea into a production-grade prompt for Claude through a short alignment dialogue; mac-cleanup safely reclaims SSD space on an Apple Silicon Mac (read-only scan, then per-batch approval).

plugins.name: prompt-crafting
plugins.description: Interviews you to nail the spec, then crafts a production-grade prompt for Claude tuned to the target model — grounded in Anthropic's official, sourced-and-dated docs. Ready-to-use by default; --template for a reusable, parameterized version.

plugins.name: mac-cleanup
plugins.description: Safely reclaim SSD/disk space on an Apple Silicon Mac. reclaim-disk-space scans read-only for reclaimable space (caches, build artifacts, dev/package caches, Xcode, Docker), then removes only what you approve — batch by batch, Trash-first, with zero data-loss surprises.

plugins.name: maintenance
plugins.description: Maintainer tooling for skill-forge. refresh-references re-fetches the official source docs behind any skill's reference library, diffs them, and proposes updates — keeping sourced references current.
